name: recipes
title: Recipes & Meal Planner
description: Import recipes by URL or hand-enter them, build a weekly meal plan, generate a shopping list, and check a recipe's ingredients against your Food Inventory and Freezer Foods ledgers.
notes: Ships a public default admin login (changeme@example.com / MyPassword) -- change it immediately after first login, User Settings > Manage Your Account. The pantry-check bridge (vault-api's /api/pantry-check) needs MEALIE_API_TOKEN set in .env after generating one from Mealie's own User Settings > API Tokens page.
